hypotheses: B slope is nearly constant and may supply no state-dependent information
Observed spend/input ratios provide additional causal information for inverse Ki scaling
Trailing-hour estimation responds faster than first-day cumulative estimation; EMA reduces estimation noise
Compare against constant Ki scaling to distinguish adaptation from scalar retuning
design.scope: Ki correction only. Frozen B predictor, frozen CMA E2 weights and Kp map, fixed target/cap1/antiwindup. Weighted integral retained, never rescaled.

methods.derivative: Existing B slope around selected base, +/-0.05 with one-sided boundary. Negative predicted spend remains clipped as in B.
methods.cumulative: First-day paper-inspired prior blend: (1-t/288)*g_ref+(t/288)*sum(past normalized spend)/(1e-6+sum(past action)).
methods.window_raw: Previous 12 completed ticks; sum normalized spend/(1e-6+sum action).
methods.window_smooth: Same trailing12 ratio, EMA alpha=1-exp(-1/6). This intraday EMA is our extension, not paper Eq7 daily smoothing.

design.guards: Exclude budget-censored feedback and action<=1e-4 from ratio sums. Window needs >=6 valid samples. Invalid/nonfinite/negative estimate falls back to unmodified Ki; zero positive-input spend is valid low gain and bounded by factor cap.
design.tuning: 24 total policies including 2 unmodified baselines; 80 development days describe sensitivity, 160 new selection days choose each family. No optimizer seeds because no stochastic optimizer or weight training.
design.choice: Within each family, min J among TE<=family baseline and UR<=baseline and V<baseline; if none retain baseline. Also freeze min-J diagnostic for every family, never auto-adopt it.
design.family_baseline: Fixed families use F0_fixed, state families use S0_CMA. Overall replacement requires S0_CMA comparison.
design.success: Primary new model must pass strict selection AND fresh mean TE/UR non-worsening and V reduction vs S0_CMA. Accuracy-only and J-improvement are separate secondary findings.
design.uncertainty: 20000 paired daily bootstrap replicates, seed20261119, 95% descriptive intervals. No multiple-comparison correction; no noninferiority claim from CI containing zero.
design.fresh_policy: Freeze ALL selected/diagnostic weights and specifications before first fresh300 evaluation; no fresh result can change primary family or powers.
design.diagnostic: Actual auction finite-difference slope uses current tape only AFTER rollout, never passed to controller. Budget uncensored potential response at base +/-0.05; not a deployable observation.
design.limitations: Uncalibrated synthetic first-price simulator; one-day episodes reset estimator; paper 30-day/2min pure-I/seasonality/input transform architecture is NOT reproduced.
